homomorphic_encryption.correctness_tolerance: max |decrypted noisy aggregate - exact weighted noisy aggregate| <= 1e-5 * max(1, max |exact aggregate|)
homomorphic_encryption.key_model: shared client key in a single-process simulation; server has public context only
homomorphic_encryption.security_basis: Total coefficient modulus 200 bits <= 218 bits allowed for N=8192 at 128-bit classical security (Microsoft SEAL parameter check)
homomorphic_encryption.server_operations: public-weight scalar multiplication and ciphertext addition; no secret key

privacy.accountant_description: For every client release, sensitivity is at most C and Gaussian standard deviation is at least z*C; T rounds compose by mu-GDP with mu=sqrt(T)/z. No subsampling amplification is claimed.
privacy.clip_scope: All floating-point model-state update entries; integer BatchNorm counters are a public function of sample counts
privacy.mechanism: client-level Gaussian mechanism on each client's clipped update before encryption
privacy.noise_calibration: client k uses std z*C*max(p)/p_k, so its weighted noise contribution alone has std z*C*max(p)
privacy.noise_distribution: independent Gaussian per client and round; entropy-seeded generator with private seed artifact
privacy.privacy_unit_description: All training data of one simulated client; add/remove-one-client adjacency with fixed public sample weights

integrated_privacy_pipeline.protocol: client clipping and independent Gaussian noise before CKKS encryption; server performs encrypted weighted sum
